decode_video_frames: decode a video file and sample frames using pyav or torchvision backend with configurable clip indexing
temporal_sampling_frames: sample a fixed number of frames at equal intervals from a tensor of video frames between start and end indices
get_clip_start_end_idx: calculate the start and end frame indices for a video clip using random or uniform sampling strategy
pyav_decode_stream_frames: decode video frames from a PyAV container within a specified PTS range with seek margin and buffer support
torchvision_decode_video: decode video frames from raw bytes using TorchVision with selective decoding and metadata tracking
